data.narrative:
Zeno Power is a Series B-stage Space & Aerospace company that has raised $50M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparison universe of 4 private peers at the same or adjacent development stage (Sierra Space at $8.0B Series C, Cowboy Space Corporation at $2.0B Series B, Aalyria at $1.3B Series B, and Skyryse at $1.1B Series C), alongside 5 public comps in the sector (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Two methods are applicable. Stage-progression modeling, using the $50M total raised as a proxy for current post-money value and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical for Series B advancement, implies a valuation of $95M. Peer-median analysis across the 4 private comparables yields $1.6B, with a range spanning $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (sector median 24.4x across 6 tickers) is not applicable due to the absence of disclosed revenue figures for Zeno Power.

Triangulating these two applicable methods produces a range of $81M to $1.9B, with a median of $872M. The wide spread reflects material dispersion within the peer set, driven primarily by the $8.0B outlier (Sierra Space). Key uncertainties center on Zeno Power's technical progress relative to peers, path to revenue, and capital efficiency relative to comparable-stage private companies in the sector. The peer-median result carries the most weight given data availability, though stage-progression establishes a conservative floor.
